questions.question: End check, AX-12's cell against D81: the Axis status row for AX-12 says 'Effect after every failure: none, for O1, O2 and O3 alike (OP-01/D10)'. D81 amended D10: where D43's Overlapping mutation deviation is declared (Local on Windows, SFTP on a Windows server), an open OP-01 read may make an overlapping O2 replace, delete or move of that item fail, which leaves the state as it was before. How should the cell read?

options.label: Cite D81's exception (Recommended)
options.description: The cell adds: except that, where D43's Overlapping mutation deviation is declared, an overlapping O2 mutation of the item may have failed while the read was open, leaving the state as before it (OP-01/D81). One cell then says everything AX-12 asks about O2. Source: D81, axes.md AX-12 ('what may O2 or O3 observe').

options.label: As is
options.description: Unchanged. The failed read itself still has no effect, and D10 as D81 amends it carries the exception. A reader of the cell alone does not see that a read can block a write.

questions.question: End check, D107 in the Axis status rows: D107 (no axis in its heading, decides note O62) amends D41 (AX-14) and D43 (AX-15). Its precedent, D75 (no axis, decides note O40, amends D8 and D42), is cited in the AX-3 and AX-15 rows. D106 and D108 amend no axis's decision and are cited nowhere, as D68 is. Is D107 cited?

options.label: Cite in AX-14, AX-15 (Recommended)
options.description: D107 joins the AX-14 and AX-15 rows, following D75's precedent: a decision with no axis is cited on the axes of the decisions it amends. Source: D75's citation in AX-3 and AX-15.

options.label: Cite nowhere
options.description: D107 stays out of every row, like D68, D106 and D108. The rows then cite only decisions headed by their axis or deciding an item they list, and D75's citation is left as an outlier.
